5192.title: Incremental maintenance monopolizes the event loop
5192.rootCauseOneLine: The hourly maintenance sweep runs one synchronous 20,000-page vacuum without yielding to queued event-loop work.

prReviews.verdict: Static review only: chunking with event-loop yields addresses the verified mechanism; PR code was not executed.

5192.proposedFix: Bound each incremental vacuum chunk and yield between chunks while retaining the total maintenance budget and lock-wait behavior.
5192.caveats: 259 MiB migrated in-memory reproduction; production 9–69 s durations not measured. Both clean runs performed by the same agent. Complete regression test and outputs are inline; raw artifacts remain outside the public reports repository. No duplicate fix PR: open PR #5193 already closes the issue.
